summary: Enlivex Ltd. filed a 6-K furnishing a July 29, 2026 press release updating Rain protocol trading metrics for its prediction-markets treasury portfolio. The filing reports July 2026 trading volume of $860 million (622% month-over-month growth vs. June) and the Rain Foundation's projected volumes to $1.3B (2027), $12B (2028) and $33B (2029), with corresponding fee buy-and-burn amounts. It includes executive commentary but no transaction, no special-situation event, and no deal terms. This is an ordinary business update on treasury operations, so no special-situation category applies.
